name: shy-rattlesnake
description: A perforated conference pass with 1em ticket notches, a pill badge, drifting grid, and a 3D hover tilt.
purpose: Turns admission details into a tactile ticket instead of a flat card, while staying on semantic tokens.
bestFor: showcase tiles that need a physical paper cue
avoidFor: forms that need native inputs inside the pass
